dek: Jahanshahi ordered military unit commanders to maintain the highest level of combat readiness and warned that 'in wartime conditions, any negligence or carelessness can carry heavy costs'; stressed continuous training, capability assessment, coordination, and correction of shortcomings.
sources: Brig. Gen. Jahanshahi, commander of Iran's Army Ground Forces, via Tasnim News Agency (Friday Oct 23)
fault_line: Real war footing or deterrence theater ahead of the 'absolutely possible' weekend strike?

sections.what_happened: Jahanshahi ordered military unit commanders to maintain the highest level of combat readiness and warned that 'in wartime conditions, any negligence or carelessness can carry heavy costs'; stressed continuous training, capability assessment, coordination, and correction of shortcomings.
sections.what_verified: Tasnim (original, Iranian state media family); Middle East Monitor (citing Anadolu Agency); Tribune.pk; jawawa.id; EconoTimes. MEM/Tribune/jawawa are T4 aggregators; Anadolu is wire but unverified in this chain.
sections.what_disputed: Declaratory posture order — standard wartime signaling, not itself a mobilization; no force movements or assets named.
sections.why_matters: Iran's army chief puts every unit on maximum alert hours before Barrack's weekend-strike window — the war-prep beats of a 48-hour countdown.
sections.context: Background: NEW to scans (Friday Oct 23, Tasnim) -- Iranian Army Ground Forces commander Brig. Gen. Jahanshahi orders unit commanders to maintain the HIGHEST level of combat readiness amid US strike threat; warns 'negligence during wartime' carries grave costs

totw_analysis: Our read: Iran's army chief puts every unit on maximum alert hours before Barrack's weekend-strike window — the war-prep beats of a 48-hour countdown. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Real war footing or deterrence theater ahead of the 'absolutely possible' weekend strike?
